scientific_integrity: Proved statements depend on explicit Bergman monomial moments, positive-operator Rayleigh equality, a finite Vandermonde argument and trace-norm analytic perturbation. Finite matrix diagnostics do not prove infinite-dimensional spectral claims. Historical priority is best knowledge, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to normalized analytic Bergman space on the unit disk, concentric outer circle, finitely many nonoverlapping circular holes; local asymptotics for one shifted hole; not general multiply connected sets or a global displacement monotonicity theorem.
title: Eccentric-perforation rigidity and a critical cusp in Bergman concentration
